patthana23.30:1.1: Namahaggataṃ nakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā mahaggato kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā nava.
patthana23.30:2.1: Namahaggataṃ naakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā paritto akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana23.30:3.1: Naparittaṃ naabyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca paritto abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā cha.
